Elena —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per follow-up, attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our current MSA redlines (Redwood_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf). This note outlines the sequence we recommend and asks for the one dependency we need you to confirm: whether your legal team needs the DPA countersigned before we execute the order form, or if a redline-ready DPA plus order form signature is acceptable with DocuSign routing to follow.

High-level recommended sequence (proposed):
- Week 1: Agree MAP milestones and acceptance criteria (attached)
- Week 1–2: Legal review (MSA redlines + DPA differences) — target single round of comments
- Week 2: Commercial finalization and order form draft (we prepare)
- Week 2–3: Signatures via DocuSign; engineering kickoff scheduled on signature date

If Greenfield requires the DPA to be fully signed before the order form, we can accommodate that, but it will shift the go-live by ~5 business days. Once you confirm preference, Karthik and Marissa will coordinate the internal handoffs.

Attachments: Greenfield_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual milestones), Redwood_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (our redline), DPA-diff.docx (summary of DPA variances)

Next steps: Can you confirm mechanism for DPA vs Order Form sequencing and share any procurement PO timing constraints?

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa —

Appreciate the materials and clear sequence. Quick answers from Legal/Procurement:
- Procurement: prefer to have a PO + signed order form in hand to trigger billing. We can issue PO once the commercial terms are agreed.
- Legal: we generally require the DPA to be agreed and countersigned before production access is granted; however, order form signature can happen concurrently with DPA signature (i.e., DocuSign routing OK for parallel signatures). We do not require the MSA to be fully executed before the order form is signed, so long as all commercial terms are consistent with the MSA redlines.

One ask: can Redwood provide a one-page summary of any operational controls relevant to data residency and log retention that we can drop into our legal tracker? Also, we need the MAP to call out the acceptance criteria for the pilot evaluation in clearer detail (pass/fail gates).

I'll loop Samir (procurement) for PO timing — Samir, what cadence do you need to issue a PO once terms are green?

Thanks,
